notices.short_title: Amendment of Rules Relating to Reporting Requirements for Cooling Towers
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene will hold a public hearing on March 16, 2026, on proposed amendments to its rules on reporting requirements for cooling towers.

notices.short_title: Trucking Services with Drivers and Labor
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Deluxe Delivery Systems Inc a renewal of its trucking services contract with drivers and labor, valued at $11 million.
The Department of Correction awarded Pina M, Inc. a $92,735 contract for large outside tents, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: Maintenance, Monitoring, Repair & Installation of Digital Communicator Panels, Citywide
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services awarded Trifecta Fire and Security Inc a $135,600 contract, without competitive bidding, for citywide maintenance, monitoring, repair and installation of digital communicator panels.

notices.short_title: Queens Business Solution Center Negotiated Acquisition Extension

The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded East Flatbush Village Inc a $103,943 contract for the Saturday Night Lights program through a negotiated acquisition, meaning it was negotiated with the vendor rather than put to open competition.
